messages:
alice: FYI — multiple EU customers opened tickets around 00:10 UTC with 401s after our scheduled midnight API key rotation. They're hitting the hosted API via edge proxy.
bob: saw first alert at 00:12, spikes in 401s on /v1/generate from two tenants. I grabbed a few request ids.
alice: sample req id: req_8f3a2c, tenant=tenant-72, user-agent=redwood-sdk-js/2.1. Will paste logs shortly.
carol: uploading brief logs — looks like proxy returned 401 upstream, token rejected by auth service: "invalid_api_key". No 5xx from runtime.
dave: can you check Vault audit? Rotation job ran at 23:59 UTC. I want to see whether the new secret was written and old one revoked.
eve: rotation job logs attached from infra: job rotated 23:59:02, wrote secret to path secret/data/apikeys/tenant-72, then a webhook to secrets-sweeper queued notifications.
frank: we saw 401s starting ~00:05, some clients recovered, some still failing.
alice: reproduction steps from support customer (short):
1) call POST /v1/generate with header `Authorization: Bearer <apikey>`
2) observe 401 for older SDK instances
3) restart app or refresh env to pick up new key -> success
bob: that suggests stale env or long-lived connections on client side, but why would new key be invalid immediately if vault rotation wrote new value and previous key still valid for grace window?
carol: looking at rotation job config — grace_window_seconds was set to 0 for this run (should be 300). Why? last deploy bumped defaults.
dave: ah — we shipped an override yesterday to speed rotations for a test tenant; it accidentally applied globally due to label selector bug. So previous keys were revoked immediately.
eve: also, secrets-sweeper webhook to edge-proxy-cache failed with 429 for ~00:00-00:03. So CDN/cache purge didn't propagate.
alice: timeline reconstructed:
- 23:59:02 rotation job writes new key, revokes old key (grace=0)
- 23:59:15 secrets-sweeper tries to notify edge but hit rate limit
- 00:01-00:06 clients with cached key or long-lived connections still sending old key -> auth failure
- 00:05 some customer apps restart and succeed
- 00:10 oncall alerted
bob: can we confirm whether the edge proxy caches API key validation results? I thought token check is upstream auth service per-request.
carol: we cache JWT validation results at edge for 60s by default to reduce auth service load. In this case the caching should help, but because old key was revoked immediately, cached negative/positive states are inconsistent across edge POPs.
dave: quick checks I ran:
vault kv get -format=json secret/apikeys/tenant-72
# shows new api_key: "sk_live_XXX...new"
vault audit tail | grep tenant-72 | tail -n 20
No errors writing new key but there are revoke events.
eve: infra mitigation enacted: increased secrets-sweeper concurrency, retried failed webhooks, manually queued cache-purge for EU edge POPs at 00:25.
frank: we asked customers to restart their services as a workaround; that fixed most reports.
alice: action items required:
- rollback the global override that set grace_window_seconds=0 (high)
- add a canary so the override only hits test label (high)
- make secrets-sweeper webhook retry/backoff more robust and add alert on 429s (med)
- add an infra playbook step to manually purge edge POP on emergency revocations (med)
- post-mortem notes and customer communication (low)
carol: I'll open a PR to flip the default back and add unit tests for selector logic. Also will add an eval in rotation job to verify grace_window is >= 60s unless explicitly flagged.
dave: I'll add a short retry loop to the webhook sender (exponential backoff, 5 retries) and surface 429 rate-limit alerts to #eng-infra.
eve: manual mitigations done: EU POPs cache-purge started at 00:25, finished 00:32. Secrets-sweeper queue drained at 00:28.
bob: observed 401s drop to baseline by 00:35.
frank: customers updated incident thread; some asked for credit. Support is drafting conciliatory reply.
alice: root cause summary: accidental global override set rotation grace window to 0 which revoked old keys immediately; combined with transient webhook 429s that prevented timely cache invalidation at edge, causing clients with cached/stale keys or long-lived SDK connections to get 401s until their processes refreshed keys or caches were purged.
carol: prevention: default grace >= 300s, selector fix, webhook retry/backoff, an emergency toggle to pause revocations while secrets-sweeper backs off.
dave: I'll create the follow-up tickets and link here.
deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-17T02:10Z rolled back global-rotation-override flag -> success.
alice: marking this thread resolved for now. Please add any additional notes. :thumbsup:
